question: The 5th edition of the Khelo India Youth Games 2023 was hosted in January-February, 2023 by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 5th edition of the **Khelo India Youth Games 2023** was hosted by **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The games were held between **January and February 2023**.
 
• Madhya Pradesh has been chosen to host this edition due to its excellent sports infrastructure and facilities.
 
• The event aims to identify and nurture young sporting talent from across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khelo India** is an initiative by the Government of India to promote sports and fitness among the youth.
 
• The program was launched in **2018** and has since become a prominent platform for young athletes.
 
• The **Khelo India Youth Games** is an annual event that features multiple sports disciplines and sees participation from young athletes across India.
 
• The initiative also includes the **Khelo India School Games, Khelo India University Games, and Khelo India Winter Games**.
 
• The primary objective is to encourage mass participation and create a strong sporting culture in the country.
